label: Live: HTTP Responder
description: Demo node for an HTTP live connection driven through the ctx. Reads the caller's request off the handle, streams two progress chunks, then sends a final JSON body echoing what they sent. Wire under a Route trigger.

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: The body key the Route trigger declared and delivered; echoed back beside the body read off the handle.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: Fires true once the response has been sent.
